[[File:Dragon hunter wand detail.png|130px|left]]
The '''dragon hunter wand''' is a one-handed [[Weapons/Categories#Staff|staff]] and [[wand]], and [[dragonbane weapon]] requiring level 65 [[Magic]] to wield. It is obtained as a rare drop from [[the Hueycoatl]].

The wand's dragonbane [[passive effect]] is that its accuracy is increased by 75% and damage increased by 40% when fighting [[draconic]] creatures, such as [[wyrm]]s, [[wyvern]]s, and [[hydra]]s (but not [[Elvarg]] or [[revenant dragons]]). This stacks multiplicatively with the [[Slayer helm (i)]] or [[Elite Void Knight equipment]], but not the [[salve amulet (i)]]. 

The wand can also autocast spells from the [[Standard spellbook]] and the [[Ancient spellbook]].
